messages.subject: Re: Unable to get beyond GGIR Part1 processing ..
parts:
May I ask why are you trying to run part 1 and 2 separately? Probably your issue comes from a misdefinition of the directories in your GGIR script. I would try to run parts 1 and 2 on a go with mode = 1:2. Let us know if this works.

Best,
Jairo
